input: Find a local debate club for adults

gold.taskTitle: Find a Local Debate Club for Adults
gold.taskDescription: Research and identify a local debate club suitable for adults to join.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood should the search focus on?
questions.description: Identify the specific location to narrow the search to nearby clubs.

questions.title: Are you a complete beginner or experienced debater?
questions.description: Understand the user's current skill level to match the right club.

questions.title: What debate format interests you most?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user prefers formal formats like British Parliamentary, Oxford-style, or casual discussion-based groups.

questions.title: Which days or times are you available to attend?
questions.description: Determine scheduling availability to filter clubs by meeting times.

questions.title: Do you want a free club or are you open to paid memberships?
questions.description: Understand budget constraints to include or exclude paid organizations.

questions.title: Are you looking to join for fun, competition, or skill-building?
questions.description: Clarify the primary motivation to recommend the most fitting type of club.

questions.title: Do you prefer in-person meetings over fully online ones?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants a physically local club or would consider virtual options.
